newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Cigar stake cut by group.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Cigar stake cut by group.

text.p: A group including Capital Management Inc, a San Francisco-based investment firm, said Wednesday it had cut its stake in Consolidated Cigar Holdings Inc to 2.1 percent, or 130,000 shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the sale of 273,900 shares within the past 60 days at prices ranging from $25.875 to $32.50 a share.
The group holds its stake in the New York-based cigar maker for investment purposes, according to a previous filing.
